description_zh: 停止一个运行中的服务
kebab_example: aliyun eas stop-service --cluster-id cn-shanghai --service-name foo --region cn-hangzhou
name: StopService

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the service
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the service. For more information about how to view the service name, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/412109.html
parameters.help_zh: 服务名称。如何查看服务名称，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/412109.html
parameters.name: service_name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run on the request. Valid values:
true: A dry run is performed and the operation is not executed. If the request fails the dry run, an error is returned. If the request passes the dry run, the DryRunOperation error code is returned.
false: A normal request is sent.
Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。

true：发送检查请求，不会真正执行操作。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码 DryRunOperation。

false（默认）：发送正常请求
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性
parameters.name: client_token

Message.description_en: The message returned in the response
